newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 7.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Bank lenders' support saves Eurotunnel from filing for bankruptcy.

-- Eurotunnel presents debt-restructuring agreement, says existing shareholders will retain 54.5 percent of capital, lender banks to take 45 percent of capital at a price of 10.40 francs per share, hopes to be able to pay dividends in the next ten years.

-- Both BNP and Societe Generale to bid for 67 percent controlling stake in CIC bank. BNP to sign co-operation agreement with Dresdner Bank. Savings banks Caisses d'Epargne to decide this afternoon whether to put up a bid.
-- Accor appoints Jean-Marc Espalioux chairman of the company's new management board under a move to transform the leisure group into a limited company.
-- Compagnie Maritime Belge to join publisher Balland in bid for shipping company CGM.
